title: Claims Handler - Household
company: Red Dot Search UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Household Claims Handler Bolton £26,000 - £28,000 Mon-Fri, 9-5

Experienced in household claims and want your own caseload rather than a script and a queue?

We're recruiting a Household Claims Handler for a well-established general insurer just outside Bolton. You'll own household and property claims end to end - first notification through to settlement - with the authority to validate, negotiate and settle within your limits.

This is a household claims handler role for someone who already knows the work. If you've spent 12 months or more in household or property claims and you're ready to take full ownership of a caseload, this is a straight step up in autonomy and salary.

What you'll be doing
- Managing a varied caseload of domestic property claims from first notification to final settlement
- Handling FNOL calls and correspondence, confirming valid grounds to claim
- Assessing policy cover, benefits and liability against guidelines
- Validating and negotiating settlements within your authority
- Appointing and managing suppliers supporting the policyholder
- Identifying and referring suspicious underwriting or potential fraud
- Keeping policyholders updated clearly throughout the claim
- Managing your own diary and prioritising a busy caseload

What you'll need
- Minimum 12 months in a household or property claims role
- Confident telephone manner and genuine listening skills
- High attention to detail - accuracy matters here
- Comfortable moving between multiple systems
- GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above
- Holding or willing to work towards the CII Certificate (fully supported and funded)

What's on offer
- £26,000 - £28,000 depending on experience
- 35-hour week, Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm - no evenings, no weekends
- On site in Bolton with free on-site parking
- Full support and funding towards CII qualifications
- Holiday allowance that increases with length of service, plus a holiday sell scheme
- Your birthday off, and a half-day for seasonal shopping
- Contributory pension, cycle to work scheme, discounted sports and social
- Cash bonus for going above and beyond
- Casual dress, free branded clothing
- Trained mental health and first-aid staff on site

The honest bit

It's an on-site role in Bolton, five days a week. There's no hybrid on this one. If you want office-based work with sociable hours, a real caseload and a company that pays for your qualifications, it's a good seat. If you're after remote or compressed hours, this isn't the one.

Apply now and we'll come back to you to talk it through properly - including who the employer is, what the team looks like, and what the first six months actually involve.

title: Claims Handler - Third Party Motor
company: Red Dot Search UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Third Party Claims Handler - Motor & Credit Hire Bolton £27,000 - £30,000 Full or part-time

Know your way around third party motor claims and credit hire, and want the complex files rather than the easy ones?

We're recruiting an experienced Third Party Claims Handler for an established general insurer just outside Bolton. You'll handle third party vehicle and property damage claims end to end - investigation, liability, negotiation, resolution - including the disputed liability files and the credit hire challenges that need someone who actually knows the arguments.

This is a third party claims handler role with real technical weight. If you've got two years or more in motor claims or credit hire and you're tired of being handed only the straightforward files, this is the one.

What you'll be doing
- Managing all aspects of third party claims: investigation, negotiation and resolution
- Investigating liability, working with other departments and running your own enquiries
- Handling more advanced cases - high-value claims and disputed liability files
- Assessing and managing credit hire: validation, negotiation, and challenging excessive hire charges
- Liaising with solicitors, insurers and accident management companies
- Recognising and escalating potentially fraudulent activity
- Prioritising your own caseload and supporting wider team duties
- Maintaining a high standard of service with every party to the claim

What you'll need
- Minimum 2 years' motor claims experience to be considered at the upper end of the range
- Third party or credit hire experience - the more disputed-liability work, the better
- Confident dealing with solicitors and accident management companies
- High attention to detail and sound judgement on liability
- Comfortable across multiple systems
- GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above
- Holding or willing to work towards the CII Certificate (fully supported and funded)

What's on offer
- £27,000 - £30,000 depending on experience
- 35-hour week, Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm - and genuinely flexible working patterns
- Full-time or part-time considered
- On site in Bolton with free on-site parking (hybrid options)
- Full support and funding towards CII qualifications
- Holiday allowance that increases with length of service, plus a holiday sell scheme
- Your birthday off, and a half-day for seasonal shopping
- Contributory pension, cycle to work scheme, discounted sports and social
- Cash bonus for going above and beyond
- Casual dress, free branded clothing
- Trained mental health and first-aid staff on site

The honest bit

It's an on-site (poss hybrid) role in Bolton - the flexibility here is in the working pattern, not the location. The upside is the work itself: this employer is growing through new contracts and internal promotions, so the complex files and the progression are both real. If you want disputed liability and credit hire rather than a volume FNOL queue, this is a good seat.

Apply now and we'll come back to you to talk it through properly - including who the employer is, the team structure, and what flexibility is genuinely on the table.

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: School Receptionist - Part time
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Hays Education is working in partnership with a welcoming and supportive primary school in Wigan to recruit a friendly and organised School Receptionist for an ongoing temporary position starting as soon as possible.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator or receptionist who enjoys working in a busy school environment and providing a professional first point of contact for pupils, parents, visitors and staff.

The Role
- As the School Receptionist, you will be responsible for:
- Managing the school's reception area and welcoming visitors
- Answering and directing telephone calls and handling enquiries
- Signing visitors in and out in line with safeguarding procedures
- Supporting with general administrative duties including filing, email management and data entry
- Assisting with attendance and pupil records where required
- Providing excellent customer service to parents, staff and external agencies
- Supporting the wider school office team with day-to-day administration

What You'll Need
- Previous reception or administrative experience
- School-based experience is desirable but not essential
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- A professional, friendly and approachable manner
- Strong IT skills and the ability to learn school systems quickly
- The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

What You'll Get in Return
- Part-time morning hours offering a great work-life balance
- Ongoing temporary work with the potential for extension
- Competitive hourly rate
- Dedicated support from your Hays consultant
- Opportunity to gain valuable experience within a local primary school

If you're available immediately and looking for a part-time school office role in Wigan, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today or contact Hays Education for more information.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking an experienced receptionist to join our friendly team In Bolton. As a member of frontline staff you will be the first point of contact for our service users and visitors. You will need to be non-judgemental with excellent communication and listening skills. Experience of working in General Practice is desirable. You will be working collaboratively and across sites where required with Bolton Medical Centre, Bolton General Practice, Shanti Medical Centre & 3D Medical Centre You must be able to deal objectively and professionally in a calm and approachable manner when liaising with patients, staff, healthcare professionals and outside agencies. Prioritising a busy workload, being a good team player and possessing the ability to deal with a wide range of clerical and administration duties in a busy environment is also required. Knowledge of the EMIS web system would be an advantage; full training and support would be offered to the successful applicant.

title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: A medical receptionist is the primary representative of our GP Practice and is responsible for the efficient administration of all related processes in order to support the work of the clinical team. Your role will be based across the two sites of Heaton Group Health, namely Heaton Medical Centre and Dalefield Surgery. You may be required to work flexibly between these sites as service needs dictate. The ideal candidate will enjoy the challenge of working in a busy GP practice and will project a positive, friendly image when dealing with patients at the surgery and on the phone. Working pattern Two positions available - for 20 hrs per week hours between 8am - 6.30pm Reception/Admin Duties: General medical reception duties such as greeting patients, booking appointments and dealing with queries Answering phone calls Actioning tasks received from clinical staff Administrative and clerical support to clinical and management team Monitor and respond to emails on the generic practice account Liaise with external parties such as secondary care, community teams and care homes Direct patients to appropriate services Provide general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Dealing with all requests in an efficient and courteous manner. Screening enquiries for the doctors and medical staff Registering new patients at the surgery Explaining the practice procedures to new patients Accurately collecting information and personal details about patients Updating the surgeries computer system with appointments and personal details Receiving urine and blood samples and sending them off to hospital laboratories Chasing up appointments for patients with hospitals or with other healthcare professionals Contacting patients to pass on test results /messages to patients as instructed by medical professionals Arranging prescriptions for patients Maintaining a clean reception and waiting area to show a professional image Writing letters and correspondence on behalf of the surgery and medical staff Covering colleagues during times of annual leave You will be responsible for the general administrative and reception duties within the Practice and work with our established processes, policies and procedures to provide a comprehensive high-quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries. Your regular duties in this role will be dealing with telephone, face to face and electronic enquiries, booking and/or amending patient appointments and home visits, contacting patients to provide information from the clinical team and assisting patients to access our services and those available in the wider community
